_comment: H03 claim-verification gate. Each key is a module-group name exactly as it appears in app/(site)/features/FeaturesClient.tsx's MODULES array. Each value is the list of real backend module directories (unierp-api/src/modules/<name>) that back it. A module group with no entry here, or whose backing directories don't exist, fails scripts/ci/check-feature-claims.mjs.
